backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Save your profile and progress to a .zip, and restore them here or on another computer
backup.export_body: Creates a .zip file you can keep wherever you like: an external drive, a USB stick or another folder. Your profile is always included (name, photo, stats, theme and settings). Your manga isn't: it stays in your library folder.
backup.include_collections_hint: Progress, favorites, order and history of their volumes
backup.restore_body: Choose a .zip created with Hakufu. Your profile is applied, and so are progress and favorites for the volumes in your library folder that are in the same subfolder with the same name. Use it to move to another computer, even a Mac or Linux one.
backup.restore_confirm: Your profile and the progress of the volumes in the backup will replace the current ones; anything not in the backup stays as it is (and your manga files are not touched). Continue?
backup.local_note: The backup is a .zip file that stays on your computer, wherever you save it. Hakufu never uploads it anywhere or connects to the internet.
backup.restore_invalid: That file isn't a Hakufu backup. Nothing has been changed.
backup.restore_done: Backup restored: your profile and the progress of {0}.
backup.restore_done_missing: Backup restored: your profile and the progress of {0}. {1} from the backup aren't in your library folder.
